prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.6 °C (70% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.9 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.2 °C (59% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.40 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.60 s (2% below healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.31 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 787 W·min/l (105% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.9 % (47% below healthy). Minor drop in delivered flow relative to motor power indicates early internal pump leakage.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.7 bar (21% above healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.6 °C (69% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.9 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.2 °C (59% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.40 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.64 s (within 2% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.29 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 804 W·min/l (110% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.3 % (48% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.6 bar (21% above healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
